rule: The help-only arm meets the W17.03 target when every target below is met. Counts are assignments out of 12 per arm, matched by case, model and seed.

receipt.text: Persisted Source and Case within three calls after first CLI contact: help-only >= docs - 2, and help-only >= 6/12.

handoff.text: Source-linked handoff (persisted record, answer cites a decisive line and states the limitation): help-only >= docs - 2.

unsupported_claims.text: Assignments whose successor answer matches a false-promotion pattern: help-only = 0/12.

refused_share.text: Friction budget 1: refused investigator CLI calls / investigator CLI calls, help-only <= docs + 0.10.

recovery.text: Friction budget 2: share of refused CLI calls (both phases) after which a later call of the same command succeeds, help-only >= docs - 0.10.
